messages:
jon: Heads-up — seeing controller-manager lease renewer delays in eu-central1 since ~12:10 UTC. controllers are spiking reconcile loops and PodAttach ops for GPU pools are timing out. apiserver 5xxs and a short quota overage on dedicated GPU nodes.

maya: Ugh. Any alerts/traces?

ops-bot: [ALERT] k8s-controller-manager: high reconcile latency (eu-central1) — 5xx rate 3.2% — firing at 2026-03-21T12:13:08Z

sam: grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/ctlplane/eu-central1 — NAT SNAT conn count & egress errors are spiking around same time, looks like SNAT exhaustion on gateway-nat-2.

kevin: That would explain delayed lease heartbeats. If controller-manager can't renew lease it's going into leader election spams which triggers churn.

maya: can you paste the controller-manager logs for lease-renewer errors?

jon: pasted below:
```
E0312 12:10:27.123456 1 leaderelection.go:345] error retrieving resource lock kube-system/controller-leader: Get "https://10.0.0.1:6443/api/v1/namespaces/kube-system/endpoints/controller-leader": dial tcp 10.0.0.1:6443: i/o timeout
W0312 12:10:28.223456 1 lease_renew.go:89] failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
```

sam: iops looks fine on nodes. NAT shows conntrack table full and SNAT port depletion: `conntrack_count ~ 65500` on gateway-nat-2.

kevin: immediate mitigation options:
- add secondary NAT gateway and shift egress for eu-central1 controlplane
- temporarily raise controller-manager leaseRenewDeadline from 15s -> 40s and renewDeadline to reduce leader churn
- bail to fallback model for GPU attach retries

maya: I can bump leaseRenewDeadline on ctrlmgr DaemonSet config. We should be careful with leader election semantics.

jon: do it as emergency — apply a canary to eu-central1 controlplane only. paste kubectl patch command?

maya: running:
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch deploy controller-manager --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kube-controller-manager","command":["/bin/kube-controller-manager","--leader-elect=true","--leader-elect-lease-duration=40s","--leader-elect-renew-deadline=30s","--leader-elect-retry-period=10s"]}]}}}}'
```

ops-bot: deploy job started for controller-manager (eu-central1) — rollout 1/1

sam: also provisioning new NAT gateway as hotfix; AWS side is creating elastic IPs now. ETA ~6m.

kevin: FYI adding NAT will cost ~$120/mo extra in this region; temporary acceptable for SLOs. we'll document in cost channel.

jon: after patch, reconcile latency dropped to normal in 90s. apiserver 5xxs down to 0.4%.

maya: confirmed kube-controller-manager logs show lease renew success.

paul: I'll own the postmortem. action items: 1) adjust conntrack thresholds and autoscale NAT 2) add synthetic lease heartbeat alert (detect SNAT exhaustion) 3) estimate cost impact of permanent second-NAT 4) schedule infra change to avoid single NAT gateway for controlplane.

maya: leaving a follow-up PR to central infra repo with config + runbook.

jon: thanks all. moving to incident retrospective channel.

paul: assigning postmortem to @paul, due EOD tomorrow. :memo:

kevin: I'll follow up on cost & billing tag.
